title: Player Hide
description: Lightweight player visibility toggle with a hotbar item.
body:
PlayerHider is a simple and lightweight plugin that allows players to toggle
the visibility of other players using a hotbar item.

**Modes**

- All players visible - Default mode, all players are shown
- No players visible - All players are hidden
- VIPs only visible - Only players with the playerhider.vip permission are shown


**Features**

- Hotbar item cycles through modes on right-click
- Player preferences are saved and restored on rejoin
- Supports LOCAL, H2, and MySQL storage
- Fully configurable items, sounds, world, slot, and cooldown
- Lightweight - no unnecessary dependencies


**Permissions**

    
- ```playerhider.vip``` - Allows the player to be seen in VIP-only mode
